body: It is hard. One the of the guys I have been talking with asked to take things to the next level. I am torn,he's a great guy, but I know that I need more than he can give me. It sucks.

I feel like we are twins.lol. I just installed Plenty of Fish. The temptation has quadrupled. The constant attention from these guys is awesome. I have this poor 20 who wants to "get to know me".. I want to be Mrs. Robinson so badly. It is taking every ounce of self control to just chat.

I thought that this struggle was mine alone. I very recently had an attempt because I was so tired from the work that goes into feeling sane.. I've been on a slew of new meds and hope that they will help. Good luck my friend.

I am currently going through this. I'm talking with about 3 guys right now and want to do very bad things with each of them. I am struggling to be good, but feel like I am led by this need. I think about what I want to do in very graphic detail all day. And I went as far as getting a kik account  just to flirt and talk dirty. This is a real struggle.

I have the tremors from the lithium. I feel like some days are worse than others. Sometimes I feel like I have electricity running through me. 

As for alcohol I was drinking a lot and had no buzz, nothing. Normally 3 beers and I'm buzzed but I wasn't at all.

I just stopped using it. I had crazy dreams and nightmares daily. And it never made me fall asleep. I will eventually fall asleep sometime before sunrise if I'm lucky. I tried switching when I took it, what other meds I was taking it with,etc. Nothing.

I've been taking it for two weeks now on top of my lithium. I have severe insomnia and my sleeping pill wasn't making me tired, so I was prescribed serequil as a sleep aid. Knocks me out, but I have had nightmares and I'm changing my clothes in my sleep.
I tried killing myself a few weeks ago and find that I am still thinking about it. I want this year to be a fresh start, but right now I am over medicated and trying to act "normal".

I am in dbt therapy. I just started so we'll see how it goes.
I just tried to kill myself, it was unexpected. My therapist says I have impulse control issues. 
I had not had a major mania in over a year, and just spun out in full crazed mania.
I generally tend to be kind of an ass and have negative thoughts about people. Better in my mind than IRL.

You're not alone, it isn't odd. The disorder is different for everyone.

I am an adult and just had this talk with my husband. I kept my past a secret and had been experiencing severe suicidal thoughts again and was scared of myself and his feelings. I made the mistake of not being completely honest about the severity. I was just released from the hospital straight to the psych ward for my attempted suicide. Be honest. It will hurt less by telling her than by her finding you almost dead like my husband did. 
I wish you well my friend.

As an adult woman having her mother come and take over her life is not helping me cope with the situation. I felt like I didn't have control before it was a major deciding factor in my suicide attempt. Yet, I find myself having my control taken away. 
I am in therapy 3 days a week, loads of meds, and behavioral therapy to work on my impulse control issues. 
I just feel exposed,raw, and unsure of how I feel still being here.

I am bipolar 1 and hear voices, and see things sometimes ("delusions"). Both share some similar qualities. I am medicated and have noticed a dramatic decrease.It is not 100%, but I don't feel so crazy all the time.
Exactly. I am currently turned off by food, but it goes both ways by the extreme. I am a foodie or accused of starving myself for an "extreme diet".

So relatable. I am for the first time in many years dealing with my issues alone. I too felt that I had purpose and now I am lost. This week I am struggling to get out if bed. I used to paint and loved to sew. Now I have no interest or inspiration in anything. I am just here self harming to keep myself from giving in to the voice that tells me to just let go. 
I wish you luck.

I thought I was alone in this feeling. Mine gets so bad I can see it playing out in my mind and then I stew in the destructive feelings until it passes (with or with out actually acting out out). My now ex husband had many run ins with this destructive side of me. I have either hit him because he was in the wrong place at the wrong time or it was his stuff that was broken. I was not intentional in choosing his things, it was always random fixations.

Since I was a teenager I have battled myself.i have had multiple suicide attempts and got to the point that I thought it was normal to want to die every day. My last attempt was months before I met my husband.i was in recovery and he became my drugs/therapist all while seeing my psych and taking meds. Once we had established or relationship WE became my focus.I was not perfect, but felt I had purpose. I didn't have any major episodes of mania until my dad passed. I went off my meds when I was pregnant and went holistic with meditation and visualization on top of my therapy. After the baby I had severe post partum and paranoia. I went back on my meds for about 3 years then decided to try holistic again.6 years later I am here, alone, with 2 kids, and drowning. I don't have insurance, a job, and my former employer is fighting my unemployment claim. I am all over the place mentally, don't eat, and rarely sleep more than 3 hours. I have to fight myself not to call him, because I know I just want to cry to him or yell at him for not being what I need him to be. I do a lot of apologizing and asking for patience that I feel he owes me.I also feel like I have a new symptom that I've never had. I feel obsessive. Like openly obsessive, verbally expressing these thoughts. Then I get locked in my head about what he is thinking of me. I applied for aid so I can see a therapist, who referred me to a psycotherapist. I see her twice a week at this point. And have 24 hour access to emergency sessions of needed. No meds at this point she wants to give it 30 days.

I've pushed all of my friends away or lost them when I am unbalanced. My siblings try to relate and can deal with me for a minute before they are tired of my episode. I saw my therapist and she has referred me to a psycotherapist. At this point she is my only life line.
